findings.seen: The photographs show a man with short grey hair that is receded at the temples and thinning on the crown, exposing the scalp. He has a close-cropped grey-white stubble beard and moustache in all four images.
The man has a solid, heavy-set build with a thickened middle, rounded shoulders, and thick forearms. There is no sharp muscle definition, and he carries some weight around his midsection.

In the relevant photos, he wears a plain copper short-sleeved t-shirt with a crew neck and raglan sleeves. On the left chest, there is a pale cream patch with clipped top corners featuring a copper diving kingfisher. There are no other logos, numbers, or lettering visible on the shirt.
The photographs show copper athletic shorts with an elasticated waistband, reaching just above the knee. On the lower left leg (viewer's right), there is a small white Nike swoosh logo.
findings.note: The claim states there is NO maker's logo on the shorts, but the photographs show a small white Nike swoosh on the lower left leg.

findings.seen: The photographs cut off at the mid-calf, so the subject's feet and ankles are not shown.
The subject's feet are not visible in any of the photographs.

The subject is holding a pickleball paddle with a blank light beige face, a black edge guard, and a black wrapped handle. No ball is visible in any frame. In one photo, there are bags and water bottles on the ground nearby.
The club crest is positioned on the left chest of the copper shirt and is relatively small, about the size of a palm.
